_comment: The register of packages that OWE an INVARIANTS.yaml. It lives outside every declared package on purpose: deleting a package's directory must not be able to delete the record that it owes a declaration. Comparison against the tracked declarations is exact-set equality in BOTH directions, and MIN_REGISTERED_PACKAGES in package_invariants_check.py refuses a registry that has shrunk. See docs/PER_PACKAGE_INVARIANTS.md.
